title: AI Software Engineer
description:
Description
About the Role:
Our R&D team builds cutting-edge visual intelligence for the global retail industry, analyzing complex in-store scenes and dense shelf environments across major markets worldwide. We combine deep learning, modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and generative AI to extract real-time understanding from retail imagery at massive scale.
Recently, we expanded into Augmented Reality (AR) - merging machine learning, 2D/3D geometry, and computer graphics to deliver interactive, spatial experiences directly onto edge devices. As an AI Software Engineer on this team, you will focus on solving non-trivial algorithmic challenges, developing visual and multimodal architectures, and shipping production-grade solutions deployed across thousands of stores globally. Crucially, this is an engineering-first role: roughly 80% of your time will be spent writing high-quality, fully tested production code rather than conducting pure academic research.
About FORM
FORM powers the world’s two billion mobile workers as they change companies and industries for good, with mobile technology that improves execution from the frontline. FORM solutions include the AI-enabled task management platform GoSpotCheck, Trax ’s image recognition technology, and FORM OpX, all of which activate and connect teams in the field - with leaders, missions, and each other - so they can deliver success in the enterprise. With more than 25 years of experience, FORM supports 100,000+ global users from some of the world’s more recognizable global brands in 45 countries.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities:

• Software Engineering & Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and fully-tested code. Actively participate in code reviews and collaborate closely with the team using Agile methodologies (Jira) and version control (Git).

•
﻿Model Development & Optimization: Train and evaluate deep learning models and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tailored for fine-grained retail scene understanding and product recognition.

•
AR & Spatial Solutions: Design and implement features bridging computer vision and computer graphics, applying 2D/3D geometric principles to power interactive Augmented Reality workflows.

•
Edge & On-Device Deployment: Profile, optimize, and quantize non-trivial algorithms for latency- and memory-constrained edge hardware (e.g., mobile devices and embedded systems).

•
VLM & Generative AI Innovation: Work hands-on with multimodal LLMs, VLMs, and advanced prompting techniques to create next-generation automated recognition tools.

•
Algorithm Refinement & Scaling: Enhance and optimize existing algorithms to ensure high efficiency, robustness against varying store conditions, and global scalability through rigorous software architecture.

Requirements & Qualifications:

•
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying Machine Learning and Deep Learning models in production or applied R&D environments.

•
Computer Vision & Math Foundations: Strong understanding of classical and modern computer vision, along with the linear algebra, calculus, and mathematical foundations required for 2D/3D geometry and spatial graphics.

•
Multimodal & Generative AI: Practical experience working with modern LLMs/VLMs and prompt engineering techniques.

•
Core Tech Stack: High proficiency in Python, deep learning frameworks (Keras, Tensorflow, Jax preferred), and standard software development tools.

•
Research-to-Product Mindset: Strong problem-solving ability to take complex academic/R&D concepts and adapt them into robust, non-trivial, and highly maintainable production features.

•
Communication: Comfortable collaborating daily in English, both written and verbal, in a distributed international team.

•
Software Engineering Best Practices: Strong commitment to writing clean code, unit/integration tests, and using Git. Experience working within a structured team environment (code reviews, Jira, CI/CD pipelines).

We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Local Progress and the Local Progress Impact Lab work collectively to advance a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of government. About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

• Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. title: Design Lead
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We are hiring a design lead: a player-coach for someone who still loves to design while also having a passion to make other designers better.

This role sit within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

As a player-coach, you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.

• Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. Making it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.

• Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear

• Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.

• Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.

• Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.

• Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

• Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.

• Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of product design experience with 2+ years of management experience

• Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support senior designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user centered craft.

• Experience building and scaling design systems.

• AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.

• Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces

title: Firmware Validation Technician II (Onsite)
description:

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

You will be part of a high-impact engineering team that develops embedded software for Axon devices, ensuring critical evidence is captured during mission-essential moments for our customers. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented software and firmware engineers and contribute to the creation of next-generation public safety products, including body-worn cameras, in-car audio-video systems, TASERs, wireless microphones, and more.

As a Firmware Validation Engineer I, you are a key quality voice for one or more Axon products, partnering with firmware, software, and hardware engineering to ship products customers can trust. You'll own testing for your product area with increasing independence, contribute to departmental testing standards, and help leadership make informed calls on coverage, bug severity, and release risk. Your work directly shapes product quality, customer trust, and release timelines.

Location: Scottsdale, AZ
Reports to: Software Engineering Manager
Direct Reports: N/A

What You'll Do:

• Own execution of release regression (manual and automated), exploratory testing, as well as impacted areas for individual new features, scoping coverage to risk and release timelines.

• Design and maintain the test strategy for assigned products/domains: test case creation and prioritization, and traceability from requirements (PRD/Jira) through to test cases in a test management system (e.g., Zephyr Scale).

• Partner with engineering under the shift-left model: review dev-authored test plans and acceptance tests, flag coverage gaps, and own the testing that engineering can't do alone (regression, exploratory, and specialized/environmental/vehicle testing).

• Investigate and document defects; represent QA in bug triage, pushing back on premature “won’t fix” calls with reproducible evidence and customer-impact data.

• Lead release-readiness reporting including feature quality reports, test execution status, and production-vs-staging escape analysis to inform go/no-go decisions.

• Identify and drive test tooling and process improvements (dashboards for regression/performance monitoring, new test-equipment integrations, AI-assisted test case generation) to increase coverage and efficiency.

• Coordinate with Engineering, PM/TPM, and hardware/RF labs to resolve scheduling, access, and documentation gaps that block testing.

• Manage multiple concurrent test cycles and releases with minimal oversight, setting priorities across competing deadlines.

What You Bring

• 3+ years in software, firmware, or hardware quality assurance / validation engineering, ideally on complex, multi-component products.

• Experience with embedded or connected-device products (firmware and hardware-software integration).

• Hands-on experience with test case design, test execution, and automated testing methodologies.

• Working experience within a test management and requirements-traceability practice, using Jira, Zephyr Scale (or equivalent), and log analysis tools (e.g., Splunk).

• Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python or similar) and CI/CD-integrated test frameworks.

• Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Familiarity with hardware and environmental test methods: RF, GPS/GNSS, environmental chambers, and connectivity (LTE/Wi-Fi) testing is preferred.

• Experience using AI tools for test case generation,

title: Program Manager, Safeguards Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. Within Safeguards, our Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence teams work as one org: Policy Design defines what is and isn't allowed across harm areas, Enforcement detects and acts on violations, and Threat Intelligence investigates sophisticated misuse and emerging threats.

That work runs across a lot of teams and moves fast. A single decision can touch model training, detection systems, product launches, legal review, and external communications. As the org's program manager, you'll keep all of it moving: tracking the portfolio across all three teams, running the processes that connect their work to each other and to the rest of the company, and making sure the right people are aligned before decisions land.

Your work will include the operating rhythm (planning, priorities, status, and decision tracking), launch and release readiness across policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence workstreams, and the processes that support how we share our work externally, including blog posts, threat reports, and other publications. You'll work closely with the org's leadership to spot risks early, clear blockers, and keep everyone pointed in the same direction.

This role is a good fit for someone who brings structure to ambiguous, fast-moving work without adding overhead, and who can earn the trust of policy experts, researchers, and engineers alike.

Important context for this role: some of the work may involve exposure to explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. It also may require late nights or weekend work.

Key responsibilities

•
Own cross-functional program management for the Policy Design, Enforcement and Threat Intel teams, keeping workstreams across harm areas on track and visible to leadership

•
Run the team's operating rhythm: quarterly planning, priority setting, status tracking, and a clear record of decisions, who made them, and why

•
Coordinate policy work with partner teams across research, product, engineering, legal, and communications, so dependencies are surfaced early and nothing lands on a partner as a surprise

•
Drive readiness for policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence work tied to model launches and product releases, including timelines, reviews, and sign-offs

•
Own the process for the org's external publications, including blog posts and threat reports, from idea through drafting, review, approvals, and publication

•
Identify risks, blockers, and resourcing gaps across the portfolio, and escalate them with a proposed path forward

•
Build lightweight processes and tools that make the team faster, and retire the ones that stop earning their keep

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience running cross-functional programs in a fast-moving technical environment, with a track record of shipping on time across teams you don't manage

•
Ability to bring structure to ambiguous work: breaking big goals into plans, owners, and milestones, and keeping them current as priorities shift

•
Strong written communication, including clear status updates, decision records, and summaries for executive audiences

•
Experience managing review and approval processes with multiple stakeholders, such as publications, launches, or policy releases

•
Judgment about when a process helps and when it's overhead, and a bias toward the lightest process that works

•
Comfort working on sensitive topics and holding high standards for confidentiality

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer who enjoys solving problems and designing, building and scaling robust services and solutions. You’ll be working to deliver our product roadmap, choosing technologies, evaluating tradeoffs, and seeing your work through all the way to production.

At what3words, we’re proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You’ll work in technologies such as Spring, Redis, FastAPI, Docker, MySQL among many others.

This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative and ambitious team, at one of the most exciting times in this company’s life.

Essential Skills:

- Java Proficiency: Excellent Java programming skills, with significant experience in the Spring ecosystem.

- Database Proficiency: Commercial experience working with SQL & DB schema design.

- Ownership: Work autonomously, own features end-to-end, collaborate directly with PMs, QA, and other engineers.

- Distributed Systems: Experience designing and evolving microservices, including service boundaries, API contracts, and resilience when dependencies fail.

- Cloud and Containers: Hands-on experience running services with Docker and Kubernetes in AWS or a similar cloud environment.

- Reliability and Performance: Ability to diagnose production issues, improve observability, and make sound trade-offs around latency, scalability, and availability.

- Technical Leadership: Ability to set technical direction, make pragmatic architecture decisions, and raise engineering standards across teams.

- Soft Skills: Excellent communication in spoken and written English, paired with a product mindset and rigorous attention to detail.

Extra credit if you have:

- Experience working with Python, FastAPI and LLM APIs.

- Experience working with Voice AI Models.

- Experience with Agentic AI workflows for software development.

This role is an excellent growth opportunity for the ideal candidate to develop their experience and career so if you feel you meet most of the requirements and our mission resonates with you, please do apply.

The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office. While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work with your main office timezone).

Diversity & Inclusion

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to equality and inclusivity in our hiring processes and company culture.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits to all permanent employees of what3words:

- Competitive salary

- Flexible working

- 6 week remote working (work from anywhere) policy

- 25 days holiday: plus the option to buy more!

- Share options

- Private health insurance

- Wellbei

title: Crisis & Escalations Executive - Bangalore (Contractual)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

 As we continue to expand our operations across India, one of the fastest-growing bus markets in the world, we are looking for a proactive & detail-oriented Traffic Control Executive for our Bangalore location who will help us keep our services running smoothly, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success.

This is a real-time operations role, where you will be responsible for overseeing live bus operations, ensuring seamless coordination between drivers, hosts, and internal teams, and managing crisis situations calmly in a fast-paced environment. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of Flix's services, including real-time monitoring, issue resolution, and cross-team coordination!

About The Role

• Communicate with drivers and hosts via calls and messages to ensure smooth, on-time operations.

• Track and manage operational issues through Salesforce tickets, ensuring timely resolution.

• Handle crisis situations swiftly and decisively to minimize disruption to passengers and partners.

• Coordinate with Operations, Customer Support, and Global teams for end-to-end issue resolution.

• Collaborate via MS Teams and chat to enable seamless, real-time communication across teams.

• Monitor live operations and escalate deviations or incidents to the relevant stakeholders.

• Maintain discipline, flexibility, and teamwork while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

About You

• Bachelor's degree holder, preferably with 3+ years' hands-on experience in customer service, intercity travel operations, or a related field.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills and effective communication skills.

• Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and stay composed under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment; flexible to work 24/7 rotational shifts, including weekends. However, when schedules are made your personal needs are taken into consideration.

• Basic Excel proficiency; experience with Salesforce is a strong plus.

• You are fluent in Telugu and English. Additional South Indian languages and Hindi are a plus.

• You are communicative, proactive, detail-oriented, and a dependable team player.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up.

Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, real-time issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Strategic Project Manager - QA&RA / R&D
description: Über uns Kijimea - Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. title: Staff Technical Program Manager - AppEx
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a hybrid role based in our Menlo Park or Bellevue office. You will split your time between working on-site with your engineering, product, and leadership partners and working remotely, giving you dedicated in-person time for planning, alignment, and the high-stakes conversations where being in the room matters.

AS A STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Define and own the program strategy for AppEx's highest-impact initiatives, spanning application surfaces, developer tooling, AI-powered experiences, and the underlying platform, from initial framing through launch and adoption

- Lead programs that cross AppEx sub-orgs (Applications, Notebooks, Native Apps, Drivers, AIML, Developer Platform) and extend into partner organizations across Snowflake, driving alignment where no single team owns the outcome

- Partner with Directors, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Principal Engineers to shape multi-quarter roadmaps, make tradeoff decisions explicit, and build execution plans that hold up under real-world complexity

- Drive cross-org decisions on shared APIs, integration points, and developer-facing launches that touch multiple Snowflake product surfaces

- Diagnose systemic friction in how AppEx plans and delivers, and design the operating mechanisms, including AI-assisted workflows, that improve engineering velocity and predictability across the org

- Represent AppEx programs to executive leadership with clear, data-backed narratives, recommendations, and escalations that drive decisions

- Raise the bar for technical program management across AppEx by mentoring other TPMs and establishing practices the wider organization adopts

OUR IDEAL STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 8+ years of technical program management experience, ideally at a cloud software company, with a track record of owning complex, multi-team programs end to end

- Experience leading programs at organization-wide scope, where success depended on aligning several teams with competing priorities and no shared reporting line

- Deep familiarity with developer-facing products or platform engineering, and an understanding of what it takes to build great developer experiences and ship them at scale

- Strong technical depth: you work directly with engineers and architects, go deep on system design and dependencies when needed, and keep execution on track

- A proven ability to influence without authority across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-to-Market

- Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining structure and direction where none exists and making progress before all the answers are clear

- Excellent written and verbal communication, effective with engineers, executive stakeholders, and everyone in between

- Experience with modern cloud-native software development, including CI/CD, release management, and API-first development

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI products, such as LLM-powered features, agentic applications, or AI developer tooling, including the evaluation, quality, and launch-readiness challenges unique to them

- Working familiarity with GenAI

title: Distinguished Software Architect
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About The Role

Wayve is building the next generation of embodied AI for autonomous driving. As we move from developing our core technology to deploying it across multiple vehicle platforms, OEM programmes and Robotaxi applications, the complexity of our software systems is growing significantly.

We’re looking for a Distinguished Software Architect to help define how our software architecture evolves through this next phase of scale.

This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role, working across our onboard software, AI, simulation, training and inference, product engineering and Robotaxi teams. You’ll work alongside some of our most senior technical and engineering leaders to ensure that the systems we build today can scale across the products and platforms we need tomorrow.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll operate across engineering organisations rather than within a single team, developing a deep understanding of how our software systems fit together and where architectural decisions in one area impact another.

You’ll work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders to identify architectural challenges, shape technical direction and lead major changes that span multiple teams.

You’ll act as a trusted technical partner on some of our hardest engineering decisions, helping teams navigate trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and the long-term health and scalability of the overall system.

A significant part of the role will be leading through technical credibility and influence, creating alignment across teams and helping raise the bar for software design and engineering practices across Wayve.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Defining architectural direction across Wayve’s software ecosystem as we scale across an increasing number of vehicle platforms and products.

- Creating clear software boundaries, interfaces and abstractions that allow teams to develop quickly without introducing unnecessary fragmentation.

- Leading large architectural changes that span multiple engineering organisations.

- Improving how software is developed, integrated, tested and deployed across different vehicle platforms and programmes.

- Working across onboard software, AI, simulation, training and inference, product engineering and Robotaxi systems.

- Helping shape the development platforms and engineering systems that underpin how Wayve builds software at scale.

- Partnering with teams working with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to ensure our architecture can support different production environments and integrations.

- Acting as a technical decision-maker and tiebreaker on complex architectural decisions.

- Helping establish a strong engineering and design culture for building large-scale, safety-critical software systems.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You’ve operated as a Principal, Distinguished or equivalent senior individual contributor and have shaped the architecture of large, complex software systems.

- You have a track record of leading significant technical or architectural change across multiple teams or engineering organisations.

- You’re an exceptional systems thinker who can understand a broad technical landscape while still going deep where necessary.

- You’ve built or evolved software platforms that needed to operate reliably across significant scale and complexity.

- You’re comfortable making difficult technical trade-offs and can distinguish between what is right for an individual team and what is right for the broader system.

- You can influence senior engineers and engineering leaders through technical credibility rather than organisational authority.

Since its inception in 2004, Cardiff has deployed over $12 billion in capital nationwide, leveraging tech-driven underwriting and high-touch service to help entrepreneurs secure the funding they need with speed.
By bridging the gap between innovative fintech and authentic human partnership, Cardiff serves as a strategic ally to diverse industries, including construction, logistics, healthcare, and professional services.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Customer Relations Representative commands a strategic portfolio of existing corporate clients approaching the conclusion of their financing cycle. In this high-impact role, you will drive asset retention by securing contract renewals while identifying tactical expansion avenues through integrated upsell and cross-sell initiatives. Serving as the definitive strategic partner, you will empower entrepreneurs to optimize their capital access and sustain long-term operational growth.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Cultivate proactive engagement with corporate accounts nearing contract maturity to evaluate capital reinvestment, facility renewals, and incremental financing opportunities.

• Diagnose and articulate advanced funding architectures that align with strategic operational expansion and long-term business objectives.

• Function as the authoritative strategic advisor for a dedicated portfolio, facilitating comprehensive status reporting and securing authentic human partnership.

• Navigate sophisticated client stakeholders through the end-to-end renewal lifecycle to ensure seamless asset retention and capital continuity.

• Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline and document strategic borrower interactions within CRM frameworks to provide executive stakeholders with full operational visibility.

• Consistently achieve or surpass formalized monthly benchmarks for portfolio retention, contract renewals, and integrated upsell initiatives.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of demonstrated performance in account management or renewal-focused sales, with a distinct preference for alternative commercial finance and merchant cash advance expertise.

• Documented history of achieving success within high-velocity, transactional commercial environments.

• Exceptional relationship management competencies and advanced negotiation capabilities to secure long-term client partnerships.

• Advanced technical proficiency, including mastery of CRM frameworks-Salesforce expertise is highly regarded.

• Strategic prospecting mindset, featuring the capability to autonomously identify and activate opportunities within expansive corporate databases.

• Self-directed professional with superior verbal and written communication skills and disciplined time management.

• Proven ability to maintain peak operational performance within a remote-first, fast-moving organizational structure.

WHO YOU ARE

• You are highly organized and naturally proactive

• You thrive in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities

• You enjoy solving operational problems and improving systems

• You communicate clearly and follow through consistently

• You balance strategic thinking with a willingness to execute

THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF YOU:

• Prefer highly structured corporate environments

• Need extensive direction or oversight

• Dislike fast-changing priorities

• Prefer maintaining systems over building and improving them

HOW WE WORK

• High ownership and accountability

• Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy environment

• Collaborative and solutions-oriented culture

• AI-assisted workflows and continuous improvement encouraged

• Strong preference for people who improve systems, not just maintain them

BENEFITS & PERKS

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k)

• Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays to promote sustainable performance and balance.

title: Founding Implementation and Ops Lead
description:
Paxos Health https://www.paxoshealth.com is a Seed-stage healthcare AI startup that has raised >$7M in venture capital funding, with a product already operating in production with customers. Our founding team comes from Stanford, Meta, Microsoft, Medtronic, Columbia, University of Waterloo, and has founded previous startups and healthcare nonprofits.

We are building the AI-native operating system for getting patients access to the medical technologies their doctors prescribe. Too often, even when a physician decides a patient needs a healthcare product (heart valves, cancer tests, genetic diagnostics, prosthetics, neurostimulation devices, home medical equipment, etc.), health insurance companies deny coverage, and breakthrough technologies struggle to reach the people they were built to help.

We help healthcare manufacturers fight for coverage patient-by-patient. Before LLMs, this work was too difficult to use AI technology for, and human teams were forced to cut corners to get through all of the patient cases. But now, AI can help manufacturers meet increasingly complex insurer requirements and get more patients access to care.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Paxos Health https://www.paxoshealth.com/ is looking for a hands-on Founding Implementation and Ops Lead. As our first business hire, reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the work that gets customers live on our platform and help build the operations that let a small team move fast.

About 70% of your time will go to customer implementation, where you'll be the bridge between our customers and our technical team. You won't build the product AI workflows or software yourself, but you'll understand AI well enough to know what's possible, spot gaps, and judge whether outputs meet customer needs. The rest of your time goes to leading critical company operations.

This is a doer's role with real ownership. As we grow, you'll have opportunities to lead the operations team, build out a customer success team, or help establish our product function.

You can expect a fast-paced, intense, and dynamic working environment where everyone has strategic ownership. We are a small team where everyone works directly with the founders. We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously, and we are building a culture that prioritizes constant learning and feedback.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead customer implementations end to end, translating each customer's workflows, templates, data, and past cases into precise requirements for our technical team.

- Test AI outputs against real customer cases and confirm workflows meet customer needs before go-live.

- Serve as the customer's main point of contact through go-live and beyond, tracking adoption and flagging issues early.

- Build playbooks, templates, and automation so every customer goes live faster than the last, and bring customer insights back to the team to make our platform more configurable.

- Build AI workflows and automations to scale internal operations.

- Support sales with proposals, pipeline tracking, and implementation scoping for new deals.

- Help run patient-facing programs, including portal setup, intake automations, and patient communications.

- Support hiring, from interviews to onboarding, and manage our vendors and internal tools.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in implementation, solutions, consulting, customer success, product, engineering, or a similar role, ideally including time at a startup.

- Strong technical aptitude and hands-on AI fluency. You pick up new tools quickly, use AI to get real work done (including building your own workflows), and can judge whether AI outputs are good enough to trust.

- Confidence leading working sessions with senior customer stakeholders and translating between customers and engineers.

- Proven ability to juggle many workstreams without dropping balls.

- A bias toward rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself, with the judgment to own

Bei Mesalvo geht es nicht nur um Technologie - es geht um Menschen, um Fortschritt und um die Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für alle. Wir sind ein Unternehmen, das von der Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und modernste Technologien angetrieben wird.
